name: Do M na High Elf-san to Isekai Haramase Slow Life
original_name: ドＭなハイエルフさんと異世界孕ませスローライフ
source:
The High Elf that you met in a fantasy world setting turned out to be a total masochist!?
Enjoy a sweet and flirt but also a little bit perverted and hardcore baby making life~!

You are living your everyday normal life when,
one day, you are summoned to a fantasy world!

Confused and disoriented, before you appears an Elf!?
It's love at first sight and you are such a lucky pervert getting to kiss her by accident!
From there on, the two of full into pure(?) love!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE202655.html]DLsite English[/url]]
